history.content: honestly not sure what this app even does but ok. i'm kind of annoyed today
Hey, that’s fair, we can just take it as it comes. “Kind of annoyed” feels like the main thing here, or is it leaning more toward frustration or being rubbed the wrong way?
more like rubbed the wrong way. it's my boyfriend. he said he'd handle dinner with his family this weekend and now suddenly i'm the one organizing everything again

“Rubbed the wrong way” fits, and there’s also something about having to pick up the organising again. What feels strongest here, the unfairness, the being put on the spot, or the sense of being left to carry it?
the unfairness mostly. it's not the first time. he volunteers for stuff to look good then it lands on my plate. i texted his mom the menu, booked the table, all of it. again
There’s a lot of unfairness in that, and the “again” makes it sound like this has a history. I’m noticing the protest in it more than anything soft or vague.
yeah protest is right. i'm not sad about it, i'm just done being the default planner. honestly though what is this supposed to do for me. you're just kind of repeating me back
Fair pushback, I am repeating back what you’re giving me. If you want, I can stay with the edge of it and not mirror so closely, or we can leave it here.
i guess saying it out loud helped a little. what i actually want is for him to notice i'm carrying it without me having to spell it out every single time. that's the part that gets me
That lands as wanting to be noticed without having to do the work of proving it first. Is it more hurt, or more protest, when that part hits?
bit of both i guess but mostly protest. anyway this was alright, better than i expected. i should actually go talk to him instead of typing at an app. thanks
Glad it helped a bit. You can leave it here, and I hope the talk with him feels clearer than the organising did.
